commits.message:
fix(frames): a feed's frame waits for every event turn out to the renderer (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.cwq)

A statusline request crosses to the renderer twice and the renderer is one
loop, so at 60 fps each crossing could land behind frames asked after it.
The host's path to the renderer now says when no event turn is out, a feed
asks for its frame only then, and the feed summary says how long each frame
was held.

chore(demo): the demo and the gallery are deleted (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.7q2) (#764)

* chore(demo): the demo and the gallery are deleted, with their scripts, their test and their zone row (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.7q2)

Each assembled its own draw from renderer internals, so every change to
those internals paid to keep them compiling; nothing in CI, release or
the docs ran either. What existed only for them goes too: the repo gate
a one-shot load built (its one test builds it inline), and the exports
of loadChain, subscriptionsOf and buildRenderState. Comments, memory and
the live docs stop naming them; dated reports and inventories keep the
record of what was measured then.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(demo): the examples render through check, and comments the deletion left stale say what is true (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.7q2)

Every payload carries a resume command now that only composePayload builds
one, so the toolbar's ⎘ resume is drawn ungated.

* fix(demo): comments that list a preview signer's or a spelled session id's callers name them all (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.7q2)

* fix(demo): the resume command has no default, because every payload carries one (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.7q2)

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(usage): a forked or resumed session's copied history counts once, in the session it was copied from (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.au0)

Claude Code marks each entry it copies into a fork's transcript with
forkedFrom. Across the 80 newest transcripts here, all 947 response ids
held by more than one file have exactly one unmarked copy, so the fold
skips copied entries and needs no set of response ids.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
